title: Shapes of light: singularities of slant functions and the Gauss map of a surface
summary: The slant function on a regular surface in three-space, introduced by Koenderink, is the inner product of a fixed light direction with the unit normal; under the standard Lambertian model it gives the brightness of the surface illuminated from that direction. We study the singularities of this function and show that their type is characterised by the differential geometry of the parabolic set and its spherical image under the Gauss map.
